goal: Post the newest video in my phone's gallery to my Instagram story with a poll sticker that asks "Sunrise or sunset?" with the options "Sunrise" and "Sunset"
warnings: step 1: check present: {text='Today', resource_id='fast_scroll_container', kind='Text'} names a scroll indicator; dropped
step 2: its target matched 8 look-alikes on the recorded screen; now the first of them in its list, which must show {text='Open camera', kind='Button'} (the list's start)

wonder.name: instagram_post_video_story_with_poll
wonder.intent: Post the newest gallery video to an Instagram story with a poll sticker
wonder.description: Opens Instagram story creation, selects the newest video from the gallery, adds a multi-option poll sticker, enters the requested question and two answer options, and confirms placement of the poll sticker on the story.
patterns: Post my newest video to my Instagram story with a poll
Add a poll sticker to my latest gallery video on my story
Create an Instagram story from my newest video with a two-option poll

inputs.name: poll_question
inputs.description: The question displayed on the poll sticker

inputs.name: poll_option_1
inputs.description: The first answer option for the poll

inputs.name: poll_option_2
inputs.description: The second answer option for the poll

steps.intent: Tap 'Your story' to open story creation
Select the newest video thumbnail in the gallery
Tap 'Stickers' to open the stickers panel
Tap 'Multi-option Poll Sticker' to add a poll sticker
Type {{poll_question}} into the poll question field
Tap the first poll option field to edit it
Type {{poll_option_1}} into the first poll option field
Tap the second poll option field to edit it
Type {{poll_option_2}} into the second poll option field
Tap 'Done' to place the poll sticker
